about: Choom recall benchmark. Each case is something that was true at a moment; each probe asks one Choom about it AS OF that moment (nothing written later is visible). An item counts as TRUTH when it matches `topic` and `truth`; as STALE when it matches `topic` and `stale` but not `truth`. Queries: short = a 1-3 word lookup (what the wake-up grounding now asks for), question = natural wording, note = the real follow-up text that fired stale at that moment (when there was one). Built 2026-09-28 from the owner's announcements and the self-followup queue.
